QuestInfo.name: Alcaster's Concerns
QuestInfo.0: The moment #p2020005# felt your Demon Fury, he refused to speak to you. How can you convince him to talk?
QuestInfo.1: #p2151009# told you that if you find out what #b#p2020005#'s#k needs and help him out, he might come around. Try listening in on him during his research. He might mention something.
QuestInfo.2: Since you got #p2020005# a #t4000042#, he said he will listen to your story.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 11,980
Can proceed to The Story Thus Far

0.0: #h0#, did you find #p2020005#? \r\n#L0##bHe refused to speak with me. I believe he sensed my Demon Fury...#l\n#k
0.1: Well, that's a pain. Maybe you should try doing him a few favors. You know, prove you're not evil incarnate anymore. He does a lot of research, so I'm sure there's something he needs help with.\r\n#L0##bDo you have any suggestions?#l\n#k
0.2: Hey, do I look like a researcher? Go keep an eye on him, and see if he mentions anything he needs.

yes.0: Hide out near #p2020005# and listen to him. He might say something important.

no.0: I do not believe he will consent to speak with you again. Do you have any other ideas?

1.0: You're wasting your time. I have nothing to say to you.\r\n#L0##bI know you can sense my Demon Fury, but I assure you, I am not working with the Black Mage. In fact, I seek to destroy him, once and for all.#l\n#k
1.1: You realize how hard that is for me to believe, don't you?\r\n#L0##bYes, I do. I also understand that trust is not given freely. That is why I have brought you this.#l\n#k
1.2: You brought me #t4000042#... Hm. I was indeed looking for this. Very well. I will hear you out, but do not test my patience. You have not earned my full trust yet.

yes.0: Just a moment...I need to organize this first.. Talk to me again later.

item.0: Hm... Blast, I'll need #t4000042#s to continue my research. I suppose I'll have to find an adventurer to go get them from #m103000000# for me... \n\nSay, you look like an adventurer with nothing better to do...
